faq_heading: Southwest condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Southwest. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Southwest, Maple Ridge: 8 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 38% on only 8 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 7 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Southwest fell from 11 in June to 8 in September (−27.3%), and 7 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.8% of Maple Ridge’s 286 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Southwest?
Southwest also had 41 houses listed and 9 sold in September, against 8 condos and townhomes listed. The Southwest houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Southwest?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 8 condos and townhomes listed in Southwest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Southwest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Southwest had a sales ratio of 38% on only 8 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Southwest from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 7 condos and townhomes sold in Southwest over those 4 months, out of 184 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
